full_prompt_en: A square long-exposure photograph shows a dark domestic dining room whose windows, doorway, furniture, and wall edges are traced with delicate white light. The underlying room is dim blue-black, with only enough ambient detail to reveal old wooden floorboards receding toward the back. On the left wall, two rectangular windows sit above a low radiator; bright repeated strokes follow the window frames and their shallow recesses. A small dining table and several dark chairs stand in the center-left foreground, their legs and backs outlined with thin luminous marks. High near the center, a simple pendant lamp hangs as a mostly dark shape against the ceiling. At the far center, an open doorway is the brightest area, its frame built from several closely spaced white passes that lead into another shadowed room. The right side contains a tall dark wall or cabinet edge close to the camera, while more luminous lines sketch the corner and door trim beyond it. Across the floor, long parallel light traces follow the boards toward the doorway, making the room's perspective unusually visible. The traced lines are slightly imperfect and layered, so they look hand-drawn in space rather than like fixed neon tubing. Cool white light dominates the outlines, with faint blue glow in the surrounding darkness; shadows remain broad and deep beneath the table and along the near right edge. The camera looks into the room from a low, steady position, preserving the architecture while the mobile light source records repeated gestures. No person is visible, and no writing can be read. The overall composition is quiet but uncanny, turning an ordinary interior into a transparent wireframe of glowing lines suspended in darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形长曝光照片呈现一间深暗的家居餐厅，窗、门、家具和墙面边缘被细白光轨描出。原本房间是昏暗的蓝黑色，只有足够的环境细节让旧木地板向后方退去。左墙上，两扇矩形窗位于低矮暖气片上方；重复的亮线沿着窗框及其浅凹处行走。小餐桌和几把深色椅子立在中央偏左前景，桌椅腿与靠背由细亮痕迹勾出。靠近上部中央，一盏简单吊灯作为大部分保持深色的形状悬在天花板下。远处中央，敞开的门洞是最亮区域，门框由几道靠近的白色光线构成，引向另一间阴影中的房间。右侧是一道靠近相机的高深色墙缘或柜缘，更多发亮线条勾出其后的转角和门框。地板上，平行长光痕沿木板通向门洞，使房间透视异常清楚。这些描线略不完美且相互叠加，看起来像在空间中手绘，而不是固定霓虹灯管。冷白光支配轮廓，周围黑暗带淡蓝辉光；桌下和右近缘的阴影依然宽广而深。相机从低而稳定的位置看入室内，建筑保持不动，移动光源则留下反复动作。画中没有人物，也没有可读文字。整体构图安静却奇异，把普通室内变为悬在黑暗中的透明发光线框。
style_prompt_en: The long-exposure photographic method sketches volume with thin luminous paths against a deep, cool-toned field. Repeated light passes accumulate around important edges, creating a gently vibrating outline rather than a single perfect stroke. Dark surfaces remain partly visible beneath the traces, giving the drawing physical depth and preventing it from becoming a flat diagram. Parallel lines can reveal receding planes, while brighter clustered contours establish a clear focal zone. Cool white and faint blue dominate, with only restrained ambient warmth. The light has little conventional cast shadow because it is itself the drawing instrument; broad shadows persist in areas the traces do not cross. The composition balances a bright far center against quieter dark margins. The overall effect is spectral and spatially precise, turning familiar solid forms into fragile, hand-drawn structures of light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种长曝光摄影方法在深冷色域上以细亮光路勾勒体积。重复的光线行进在重要边缘积累，形成轻轻颤动的轮廓，而不是一笔完美直线。暗表面在光痕下仍部分可见，使绘线具有实体纵深，不至于成为平板示意图。平行线可揭示后退平面，更亮的聚集轮廓则建立明确焦点。冷白和淡蓝占主导，仅保留克制的环境暖色。光本身就是绘画工具，因此少有常规投影；光痕未经过的地方仍有宽阔阴影。构图以明亮远中心平衡更安静的暗边缘。整体效果幽灵般而空间精确，让熟悉的实体形态变成脆弱的手绘光结构。
theme_en: A dark dining room outlined by delicate white light trails
theme_zh: 一间深暗餐厅的轮廓被细白光轨描出
name: Light tracing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
